Neugebauer, co-founder and largest shareholder of Fermi Inc., disclosed that the company has dropped its lawsuit against him, which was filed to validate a 70% supermajority bylaw amendment, after a Texas Business Court ordered the company to produce documents and testimony explaining the rationale for the bylaw. The move is seen as a significant development in the ongoing governance dispute at Fermi, with Neugebauer arguing that the board's actions were an attempt to entrench itself and avoid scrutiny.

general.title: Canada Exports to US Surged in August Ahead of New Tariffs
general.summary: Canadian exports to the US rose sharply in August as importers appeared to rush to get ahead of new tariffs imposed by the Trump administration toward the end of the month.

general.title: Pimco Touts Diversification Need as Yields Lure at 24-Year High
general.summary: Pacific Investment Management Co. says bond yields at multi-decade highs offer attractive income for investors, who should spread their allocations across developed and emerging markets to help protect against fiscal risks.

general.title: Uber to Buy EzCater for $2.3 Billion in Enterprise Delivery Push
general.summary: Uber Technologies Inc. is buying catering firm ezCater Inc. for $2.3 billion in a cash deal that will help the Uber Eats delivery platform reach a more corporate clientele.

general.title: Morgan Stanley's Lord Sees More Room for Euro to Fall
general.summary: Morgan Stanley's FX and Emerging Markets Strategy Head James Lord said the euro could fall further toward $1.10 as risks mount. He joins Bloomberg's Anna Edwards, Tom Mackenzie, and Guy Johnson on "The Opening Trade" discussing France, Europe as a whole, and the election in Brazil. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Meta Muse gives AMD a boost as AI momentum shifts to personal agents
general.summary: The personal agent boom is lifting the fortunes of AMD and Intel, which have outperformed their megacap tech peers over the past month.

general.title: Wayve CEO Kendall on the Future of Driving
general.summary: Wayve CEO Alex Kendall discusses the future of driving, the market for autonomous vehicles in the US and China, as well as the possibility of a future IPO. He spoke with Bloomberg TV's Tom Mackenzie on the sidelines of the JPMorgan Tech Stars conference in London. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: S&P 500 Sets First Record Since August as Bulls Downplay Risk
general.summary: The S&P 500 rose 0.6%, reaching its first record high in two months, buoyed by resilient corporate profits and a pullback in oil prices.

general.title: UAE's Al Bannai on AI Developments
general.summary: Faisal Al Bannai, adviser to the President of the United Arab Emirates, speaks with Bloomberg's Alex Dooler at the 'AI Everything' conference in Abu Dhabi. He talks about the launch of a new model of Falcon AI that's more attuned to the Emirati dialect, as well as saying he sees some exciting start-ups in the fields of robotics, driving and security. (Source: Bloomberg)
